method: Manual review of named dataset descriptions in experimental sections of 3 publicly available paper full texts, plus first-party UCI metadata. No automated or exhaustive full-corpus plagiarism/novelty check, and no confidential/private local-source access.

reviewed_full_texts.title: Particle Competition and Cooperation for Semi-Supervised Learning with Label Noise
reviewed_full_texts.evidence_note: Full experimental section includes Semeion and g241c, NOT present in the frozen PyPCC 20-set performance_campaign_plan inventory; therefore that 20-item list is NOT an exhaustive historical PCC-paper exposure registry.

reviewed_full_texts.title: Analyzing and Inferring Distance Metrics on the Particle Competition and Cooperation Algorithm
reviewed_full_texts.evidence_note: Author explicitly identifies the three experimental datasets, normalizing Wine and Banknote in some conditions. This is limited to this 2017 paper.

reviewed_full_texts.title: Graph Convolutional Networks and Particle Competition and Cooperation for Semi-Supervised Learning
reviewed_full_texts.evidence_note: The complete named seven-dataset table was read from the publicly retrieved paper text. A page screenshot request against the publisher was blocked (403), so the result is grounded in extracted textual content, not screenshot-verified rendering.

known_historical_inventory_limitation: The 20 datasets named in PyPCC docs/performance_campaign_plan.md do not include g241c or Semeion appearing in 2015 published work. The 20-item inventory is not exhaustive for every publication, version, collaborator or historical local experiment.

source_metadata.citation_as_given_by_uci: Barreto, G. & Neto, A. (2005). Vertebral Column [Dataset].
source_metadata.original_description: Orthopedic patient biomechanical observations collected by Henrique da Mota during residency at GARO, Centre Médico-Chirurgical de Réadaptation des Massues, Lyon, France. 310 patients in 3-class version, 6 numeric features.
source_metadata.risk: Clinical-origin data with no independently verifiable patient/visit IDs in numeric source; public license not a substitute for data-use/privacy ethics or patient-independence proof.

source_metadata.citation_as_given_by_uci: Çinar, İ., Koklu, M., & Tasdemir, S. (2020). Raisin [Dataset].
source_metadata.original_description: 900 raisin grains, 450 each Kecimen/Besni, morphological features extracted from image processing; introductory paper from 2020.
source_metadata.risk: Tabular morphological descriptors do not establish independence of photographed physical grains, acquisitions or image-processing batches.

source_metadata.original_description: 440 wholesale-distributor customers; six annual spending measures plus nominal Channel and Region. UCI metadata lists Region as target, Channel as feature.
source_metadata.risk: P1 proposal reinterprets original nominal Channel as target and excludes Region from X; separate scientific approval required. Individual client IDs, corporate groups and acquisition session IDs absent from published tabular export.

still_unreviewed: Other PCC and graph papers (including originals from 2009–2012, 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, 2026)
All conference posters, workshop manuscripts, unpublished student dissertations and source notebooks
Older source commits and public forks beyond specific MATLAB tracked 12 files
Local/private MATLAB experiment data and any collaborator-owned experiments
Whether dataset versions/classes were previously used under alternative file names or aliases
Independent patient, customer, grain or acquisition-batch lineage, consent and privacy requirements
Whether all intended data attributions, dataset licenses, third-party terms are met
scientific_implication: Exploratory-only P1 remains appropriate. Do not represent the 3 sources as externally novel/unexamined or independently sampled across domains. Do not freeze before reviewer acknowledges exposure unknowns and any prior-use declarations.
